name: District Electoral Divisions/Wards 1 Jan 1919
description: District Electoral Divisions/Wards of Ireland, before partition, as at 1 Jan 1919, assembled from Connacht (= 1919 boundaries), Leinster (= 29 Apr 1910 boundaries), Munster (= Apr 1907 boundaries), Ulster (= 1916 boundaries). Modified version of the ~20 Jan 1919 map. Soon before January 22nd 1919, following the formation of Howth Urban District, the DED of Howth was split into Howth Rural and Howth Urban.

references.label: District Electoral Divisions/Wards 1 Jan 1919 source notes
references.note: Source notes supplied by Phelim Birch with the map files.

references.label: OSNI County Series six-inch (1:10,560), County Down sheet 4, Edition 5 (revised 1931)
references.note: Shows the county borough boundary ("Co. Boro. Bdy.") in a straight line from the Inner Lighthouse at the tip of the East Twin to a boundary post on the railway at Tillysburn; Edition 3 (1902) and Edition 4 (1920-21) show the same line. The pre-1958 Belfast line in the lough east of the lighthouse is traced from this sheet. Viewed in PRONI's Historical Maps Viewer (OSNI).

references.label: OSNI County Series six-inch (1:10,560), County Antrim sheet 57, Edition 5 (revised 1931)
references.note: Shows the county borough boundary ("Co. Boro. Bdy.") in a straight line from the Antrim shore south of Greencastle to the Inner Lighthouse; Editions 3 and 4 (1901-02) show the same line. The pre-1958 Belfast line in the lough west of the lighthouse is traced from this sheet. Viewed in PRONI's Historical Maps Viewer (OSNI).

references.label: Belfast Gazette, issue 1889, 6 September 1957, pp. 243-244
references.note: S.R.&O. 1957 No. 189 (County Borough of Belfast) and No. 188 (County Down): Orders in Council under section 11 of the Boundary Survey (Ireland) Act 1854, made 29 Aug 1957, in force 1 Mar 1958, extending Belfast at Sydenham into Belfast Lough.

references.label: Belfast Gazette, issue 1965, 20 February 1959, p. 66
references.note: Notice of Orders in Council under section 11 of the Boundary Survey (Ireland) Act 1854 (Armagh, Down and the County Borough of Belfast), in force 1 Apr 1959; the Belfast order is dated 9 Feb 1959.

references.label: Belfast Gazette, issue 1979, 29 May 1959, p. 185
references.note: The Belfast Boundary Survey order of 9 Feb 1959 (in force 1 Apr 1959).

references.label: Belfast Gazette, issue 2070, 24 February 1961, p. 58
references.note: The area added to Belfast by the 1959 order "consists of reclaimed lands at Sydenham".

references.label: Census of Population of Northern Ireland 1961: County Borough of Belfast
references.note: Area 18,052 acres including 2,237 acres of tidal water; the land 458 acres more than in 1951, all in Victoria Ward, from the reclamation of land from Belfast Lough. 1951: 15,357 acres of land and 1,223 acres of tidal water.

notes: District Electoral Divisions/Wards 1 Jan 1919 reuses the converted geometry from Ulster District Electoral Divisions/Wards 1916.
